description: The most-reported problems in a community or council district for a period, each with the count for the same days a year earlier and the median days to close. Optional agency and status filters. From BoardStat (BetaNYC, NYC Open Data, 2020 on); not an official City report. 311 counts are reports, not problems; 'closed' is not 'fixed'.

agency.description: Agency code as 311 writes it, e.g. 'NYPD'.

community_district.description: 306, BK06 or 'Brooklyn 6' (all forms: server instructions). Not with council_district.

council_district.description: Council district, 1 to 51. Not with community_district.

last_days.description: The last N days of data, ending on the newest request's day (not today).

name: top_problems
